sdr.title: AI SDR Agent
sdr.subtitle: Lead qualification, intelligent automated replies, and meeting scheduling for LinkedIn & Inbox.

sdr.modeOffDesc: The module does not analyze, classify, or propose response drafts.
sdr.modeShadowDesc: AI analyzes and generates drafts in the background for audit, guaranteeing 0 outbound sends.
sdr.modeApprovalDesc: AI prepares suggested replies in your Inbox for you to approve or edit with one click.
sdr.modeAutoDesc: AI replies immediately to high-confidence messages, with strict hard-stops on complex objections.

sdr.maxAutoTurnsDesc: Limit of continuous AI replies before requiring human intervention.
